prompts.standard: Edit reference 1, the existing 4-column 2-row courier sprite atlas. Keep its EXACT north-facing orientation, 8-pose order, camera vertically above, 4x2 layout and true transparent background. Reference 2 shows the desired COMPACT 90-degree overhead body readability. REPLACE the old overlarge hood: shrink the white hood crown to half its current diameter, positioned in the forward/north part of the silhouette. This exposes dark shoulder tops, both bent elbows and forearms at the sides, two white gloves, the small mint BACKPACK at the REAR/south of the head and the two shoe TOPS behind the backpack. All eight poses must show the BACK of the character, NOT the chest. Backpack remains at bottom/south in EVERY cell, never on top/north, never disappears in walk frames. The camera is exactly 90 degrees overhead: absolutely no front face, chest front, front of thighs, standing frontal body or three-quarter view. Compact round silhouette like reference 2, with realistic 3D top surfaces and grounded anatomy. A silver steel knife with blue reflection is in the right hand, on the RIGHT side of the image, visible separate from body; phone when carrying in left hand on LEFT. Make the idle left/right arms similar size. Two separate shoe tips project from the rear during walking but no tall legs. All poses face UP (north), no rotation of torso between frames. Original palette: white hood, white gloves and shoes, black/dark charcoal clothing, mint backpack. Crisp detailed 3D mobile game assets, matte fabric. Eight equally spaced 512-square cells on 2048x1024 canvas. Body pivot at each cell centre and identical scale in every cell. 12% minimum transparent gutter. Row 1: idle, left step, passing step, right step. Row 2: knife windup on right, forward slash on right, followthrough across upper-left, idle holding phone left. NO text/grid/checkerboard/labels/shadow/floor/effects. Biggest priority: miniature hood with visible broad overhead shoulders and rear backpack in every frame, like a real top-down action game.
prompts.carrying: Create a matching CARRYING-PHONE animation atlas by editing the supplied courier sprite sheet. This is the SAME courier, exact same camera, white hood, dark charcoal outfit, white gloves/shoes, mint backpack, silver-blue knife in right hand, facing NORTH/up from directly overhead in all eight frames. Retain exact 4-column 2-row atlas, equal square cells, same body scale and same body pivot as reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Output 2048x1024 wide 2:1. MOST IMPORTANT: a small black smartphone is firmly gripped in the LEFT white-gloved hand in EVERY one of the eight frames, even running and slashing. Phone is a rigid rectangular black device with a restrained mint glass reflection, fingers wrapping the edge, not hovering; do not obscure its silhouette with body. The phone moves with the arm between animation poses. Keep a distinct right-hand knife visible. Hood is smaller and shoulders wider to read well at gameplay scale. Top-down back view, backpack south/bottom, head north/top, no face/chest front. Each entire pose inside its cell with 12% transparent margin. Row1 left to right: 1 carrying idle, 2 RUN left foot forward and right foot behind, phone arm swings back, 3 running passing stride, phone held left of torso, 4 RUN right foot forward and left foot behind, phone arm swings forward. Row2 left to right: 5 attack windup right knife pulled back while left hand protects phone, 6 right-arm forward slash with phone held left, 7 right-arm followthrough across upper-left with phone kept left/lower-left away from blade, 8 relaxed carrying idle with both feet visible. Strong readable arm and foot changes, no floating. Identical courier identity and volume all frames. No grid/text/numbers/labels/UI/weapon trails/floor/shadow/checkerboard/extra hands. Do not copy the reference's empty left hands: each must hold a visible black phone integrated into the actual grip.
